Lina C (CS Ops): Heads up — noticed a spike in duplicate touchpoints and several accounts jumped into 'at-risk' after yesterday's playbook deploy. Can @Maya D pull healthscore deltas + a small sample export? @Ethan H can you check the playbook webhook retry behavior?

Raj P (CS): Noted. Is this scoped to enterprise segment or across the board?

Maya D (Data): Quick look = big deltas concentrated on accounts with multiple rapid touchpoints. Suspect duplicate webhook deliveries + our recent healthscore weight tweak.

Maya D (Data): SQL I used to surface suspects:
```sql
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS events, MIN(event_ts) AS first_ts, MAX(event_ts) AS last_ts, COUNT(DISTINCT touchpoint_id) AS unique_tp
FROM crm_touchpoints
WHERE event_ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY events DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Ethan H (Onboard): playbook-bot shows a cluster of 502s around 23:03 UTC last night. Might be a flaky downstream endpoint + no idempotency keys on that rule. I'll re-run the idempotency patch and inspect the DLQ.

playbook-bot: webhook-delivery | ERROR 502 at 2026-03-20T23:03:12Z -> 128 retries queued. details: https://internal.redwood/playbook/retries/3942

Lina C (CS Ops): If duplicates are inflating negative signals, pause the onboarding-touchpoint enrichment rule before we replay DLQ. We should also run a one-off dedupe/backfill and temp re-score to avoid churn in renewals.

Raj P (CS): I can pause it now — will wait for a quick thumbs from ops.

Maya D (Data): Also flag: we recently bumped the last_active weight (0.6 -> 0.8) in the score config. Combined with repeated negative touchpoint flags probably amplified the drift. I'll prepare a temp-score script to compare distributions.

Ethan H (Onboard): Rolling idempotency patch now (deploying to staging -> prod). ETA ~10m. After patch I'll replay DLQ at controlled rate (10/s) to avoid spikes.

Lina C (CS Ops): Plan: 1) Pause rule (Raj) 2) Deploy idempotency patch (Ethan) 3) Export dup sample + temp re-score (Maya) 4) Run dedupe + re-score backfill then re-enable and observe for 30m. I'll write a short runbook snippet in the ticket.

Raj P (CS): :thumbsup: pausing onboarding-touchpoint-enrichment rule now.

Maya D (Data): Export done -> https://s3.redwood/exports/dup-touchpoints-394210.csv :eyes: includes schema and 200 sample rows.

Ethan H (Onboard): Patch deployed to prod. playbook-bot shows no new 502s. Starting DLQ replay at 10/s (128 items).

playbook-bot: INFO replay started | items=128 rate=10/s ETA=12.8s (link: https://internal.redwood/playbook/replay/394210)

Lina C (CS Ops): Perfect. After backfill, @Maya can you diff healthscore distribution (before/after) and flag any accounts where score moved > 0.2 so CS can triage renewals?

Maya D (Data): On it — will post a short summary and sample list in the ticket in ~15m.

Ethan H (Onboard): Replay finished cleanly, no new errors.

Lina C (CS Ops): Thanks team — once Maya posts diffs we'll decide whether to keep the weight change or revert. Filing a follow-up action item in the runbook.
